_comment: Every cancelled run in this repository as of 2026-09-14, captured from the GitHub API. Real data, not invented: the policy in scripts/monitoring/workflow-outcome-monitor.mjs is calibrated against these and must keep classifying them correctly. stepsRun counts steps with a non-null, non-skipped conclusion.

runs.why: ran 9 steps and died exactly at its 120-minute ceiling
a dispatch run can time out too — event type must not suppress it
duration can slightly exceed the ceiling
ran, but stopped at 52% — a human cancelled it
orchestrator hit its own ceiling having run 7 steps
queue eviction — 30 workflows share the data-commits group
THE CASE THAT BREAKS DURATION-ONLY INFERENCE: 104% of its ceiling with zero steps executed. Duration alone would call this a timeout and alert falsely.
